data.title: Club Drive
data.about:
An elite new luxury development, Club Drive in Dubai Hills Estate is a welcome addition to one of Dubai's most well-known and adored master communities. Designed by Emaar Properties, the apartments at Club Drive are in a prime location, with 75% of units offering breathtaking views of the nearby Golf Course.

The apartments at Club Drive, which are spread over two buildings, are all exceptionally designed. They range in size from 1 to 3 bedrooms. These residences are examples of cutting-edge architecture that fit well in with Dubai Hills Estate's luxurious vibe.

Each apartment at Club Drive, like other Emaar apartments, has been carefully designed to provide the maximum amount of space and comfort for its occupants. Club Drive in Dubai Hills Estate provides its residents with more than just high-quality residences; it also provides them with a wide range of facilities. The centrally located Central Park and Dubai Hills Mall, both of which are conveniently close to the property, are examples of the careful planning that went into its site.

characteristics_module.title: Luxury golf-course living in Dubai Hills Estate
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Luxe living in Dubai Hills Estate
  • Wake up to golf course and city views
  • A vast 2,700-acre community
  • Enjoy an 18-hole golf course
  • Shop and dine at Dubai Hills Mall
  • Explore a 54-km cycling route
  • Convenient Dubai Hills Boulevard
  • Urban-nature balance for exclusive living
  • Close proximity to key locations in Dubai

location_tile.title: Ideally Located in Dubai Hills Estate
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Nestled within the prestigious Dubai Hills Estate, Club Drive by Emaar unveils itself as a compelling addition to Emaar Properties' latest new launch. This urban haven enjoys a strategically advantageous location, set against the iconic backdrop of the Burj Khalifa and the Dubai skyline. Club Drive ensures a lifestyle that is both convenient and well-connected, with residents seamlessly accessing retail outlets, parks, hospitals, schools, and neighboring residential communities along the bustling Dubai Hills Boulevard.

  • 05 Minutes from Dubai Hills Mall
  • 12 Minutes from Mall of the Emirates
  • 12 Minutes from Dubai Marina
  • 12 Minutes from Meydan Racecourse
  • 15 Minutes from Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa
  • 15 Minutes from Burj Al Arab
